evidence.reason: a real 2x peak, but it is not what this fault rests on

spark.explanation: The 1x peak holds 99 percent of the vibration energy and is about ten times larger than the 2x peak. There is no 0.5x peak and no row of harmonics, so looseness and misalignment are unlikely. The in phase side to side motion at running speed agrees with the rule verdict of imbalance from an unbalanced spin load.
fix: Stop the machine and redistribute clothes evenly in the drum
Confirm the machine is level with all feet firmly on the floor
Run a small balanced test load to confirm the shake drops
Inspect suspension springs and dampers if high 1x persists
check_next: Recheck 1x amplitude after redistributing the load
Check leveling feet and floor firmness
Inspect drum suspension and dampers if shake persists
